reviewProvenance.manualVisualComparison: Source view 1 and production cover are the same tight portrait of brown-haired Lune in a long dark waistcoat and gray-blue outfit, with her right hand raised producing orange flames, golden geometric cube shapes and bright orange fire effects. The framing, face, arm, costume stitching and flame ribbons match; additional full statue/side views corroborate the same figure, spell effects and broken-rock base. One-bit canonical dHash difference consistent with image resampling.
